title: Where Merge’s Permissions Fall Short, and How Paragon Solves the Permissions Challenge
summary: Your integrations infrastructure platform should be robust in handling permissions. Paragon and Merge handle file permissions very differently for integrations like Google Drive, Confluence, and SharePoint. Read about the differences in design and what those differences mean for you, the end user.
body_markdown: Paragon's permissions strategy was built to handle file storage nuances from integrations like Google Drive, Confluence, and SharePoint. Read about how Paragon's approach compares to Merge's, how they work, and downstream tradeoffs.
